input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there

errors.what: First version of the McVitie-Wilson listing emitted repeats (~1 in 75) and its tree blew up (3^7 cyclic blocks: 84 s, hit work budget).
errors.fix: Added the rule that a break started at applicant i fails if it would displace an earlier applicant; repeats gone with the dedupe filter off, 3^7 now 63 ms.

errors.what: Local CI sweep: sibling-links orphan (no page linked the new tool), csv formula-guard ratchet flagged toCsv, post description/seo_title over length.
errors.fix: Footer link + test from cost-sharing-calculator; CWE-1236 guard in csvCell with a test; shortened front matter.

errors.what: Blog post first draft stated example rank totals before computing them (33 to 23); actual is 33 to 19.
errors.fix: Computed with the engine and corrected before the post was committed; caught by self-check, not by a test.

doc_friction.issue: Editing tracked files while a --for-changes sweep runs voids four workflows (correctly reported); and --only is rejected without --for-changes/--tree, so the re-run needed one invocation per workflow name.

Definition of done says ship a real public dataset as the example; two-sided preference data is confidential or under unchecked per-dataset licences (PrefLib returned 429), so the rule cannot be met for this method.
map reports prompt.md 134 lines vs budget 100, land-your-work.md and cloud-session.md over budget too.

deviations.why: No openly licensed real two-sided preference dataset was reachable
deviations.did: Shipped labelled made-up examples and said why in data/SOURCE.md and the README
deviations.result: Tool meets the rest of the definition of done; a real dataset is listed as the next addition

notes: Explore idea: stable matching as a research-algorithm tool (ventures/stable-matching); no venture README mentioned Gale-Shapley, deferred acceptance or stable marriage. Deferred acceptance with capacities, either side proposing; every stable matching (McVitie & Wilson 1971 on the seat-expanded instance); egalitarian/minimum-regret/balanced picks; rural hospitals check; blocking pairs for a supplied matching. Verification: exact agreement with Python matching 1.4.3 on 250 instances x 2 sides (eval/make_reference.py); listing equals brute force on 1,000 small instances (3,000 more during development); property tests on 400; 3^7=2,187 exact. All 10 DOIs checked on Crossref. Local CI: run_workflow_locally --for-changes then re-run of pages.yml, ventures-tests.yml, portfolio-validate.yml (100/100), portfolio-pages.yml (12/12) on a still tree, all pass; secret-reading jobs (agent-cross-review, portfolio-pages gate/deploy) not run. No agent doc in docs/reports: README Verification and the post carry what the next run needs.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: senior engineer: engine with enumeration and its debugging, reference script, page, CLI, tests, post (~3 working days)

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
